audit.whatIsWrong: The entry says Spirit's Refuge 'blocks your empowered autos and Q bolts' — in wants.foe[1], in mid, and in spikes[2].
audit.why: Riot's text is specific: 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.' It blocks basic attacks, not abilities. Radiant Volley is an ability and lands through the zone; only the empowered auto from Searing Brilliance is eaten. A Mel who believes her Q is blocked stops casting during the exact window where casting is free — and she loses the passive projectiles she was saving, because the attack that would have spent them is the one that gets blocked.
audit.corrected: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks. Hold the empowered auto and keep casting Radiant Volley through the zone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Stand United is treated purely as a scaling problem Mel cannot answer. Nothing says she can break it.
audit.why: Stand United is a channel — Shen shields the ally and teleports 'soon after'. Solar Snare is hard CC at 1000 range on an 11s cooldown, so Mel can cancel the channel and strand the ally he was saving. Against a champion whose entire scaling case is map presence, one of the few top laners who can deny it should be told so.
audit.corrected: Snare Shen the moment Stand United begins channelling; the teleport is cancelled and the 200s ultimate is spent.
sources: champ-data/_kits/shen.json (R flagged channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it)

audit.whatIsWrong: 'His E taunt dash closes your spacing on a short cooldown' — Shadow Dash is not on a short cooldown, and his energy is never mentioned.
audit.why: Shadow Dash is 18/16/14/12/10s and costs 150 energy of a 200 pool; Twilight Assault costs 140/130/120/110/100. So at rank 1 the taunt is an 18s commitment that leaves him unable to pay for his damage spell immediately afterwards. Solar Snare is 11s. The post-Shadow-Dash window is both longer and emptier than the entry implies, and it is the window the whole lane hangs on.
audit.corrected: Shadow Dash is 18s at rank 1 and drains 150 of 200 energy — the taunt buys him no immediate follow-up.

audit.why: The chart gives Shen four of seven stages against a 37.5% Mel win rate over 8 games — consistent, and the reasoning per stage matches the kit. Left alone.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 tilt to Shen and you have to play honest. His E taunt dash closes your spacing on a short cooldown, and the instant he's on you he pops W Spirit's Refuge to block your empowered autos and Q bolts while his Q-empowered swings out-trade your follow-up — you can't kite a taunt with no dash. Hold Rebuttal to break his all-in, not to eat poke. Level 6 is your one spike back: Golden Eclipse detonates all the Overwhelm you've stacked from any range, so bait his E and W down, then burst him while he can't block it.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 tilt to Shen and you have to play honest. Shadow Dash covers 600 units and taunts, and the instant he lands it Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks inside its zone — so hold the empowered auto and keep dropping Radiant Volley, which is an ability and lands through it anyway. Hold Rebuttal to break his all-in, not to eat poke. Level 6 cuts both ways: Golden Eclipse detonates your stacked Overwhelm from any range, and Solar Snare cancels Stand United while he is still channelling it.

edits.before: This is where the 37.5% lives. Shen scales into an even-to-tankier body that out-sustains your poke in a straight 1v1, and his global R means he's impacting the whole map while you're stuck pushing a sidelane you can't actually win solo. Your Overwhelm passive keeps you relevant, but he statchecks your squishy frame the moment his E taunt lands and his W blanks your burst window. Don't try to solo-duel him late — group, hold Solar Snare and Rebuttal to peel his taunt-engage in 5v5s, and let your team punish the side he isn't teleporting to.

notes: The packet's two suspectNames here are both false positives: 'Solar Snare's' is Mel's real E with a possessive, and "W's Spirit's Refuge" is Shen's real W with a slot prefix. The genuine error in that same sentence was the claim that Spirit's Refuge blocks Radiant Volley. The full layer rates this matchup FAVOURED, difficulty 4/10, with all seven phases marked Mel, against a 37.5% win rate and a content chart giving Shen four stages; diff and diffRating are too short for the applier's 12-character minimum on full-layer edits, so that contradiction needs a manual pass.
